summary: Found and corrected one catalog description issue for legacy_customer_orders.

findings.claim: The catalog description only says this is an older compatibility copy and omits the completed-order scope documented for customer_orders, which this model directly selects from.

evidence.fact: The prior description called legacy_customer_orders an older compatibility copy of customer order metrics without specifying completed-order scope.
The model selects all columns from ref('customer_orders').
customer_orders filters to status = 'completed' and groups by customer_id.
The customer_orders schema documents completed-order metrics at one row per customer and says refunded and cancelled orders are excluded.
The manifest lineage shows legacy_customer_orders depends on customer_orders; the manifest records customer_orders as completed-only.

action.value: Compatibility copy of completed-order metrics at one row per customer; refunded and cancelled orders are excluded.
action.rationale: Reflect the directly inherited scope and documented customer grain in the compatibility model’s catalog description.

verification.equals: Compatibility copy of completed-order metrics at one row per customer; refunded and cancelled orders are excluded.

changes_made.description: Updated legacy_customer_orders description to match the completed-order scope inherited from customer_orders.

verification_performed.command: python -c "import json; c=json.load(open('project/catalog/catalog.json')); o=json.load(open('project/catalog/overrides.json')); a={x['name']:x for x in c['assets']}; a.update(o['assets']); print(a['legacy_customer_orders'])"
verification_performed.result: The merged legacy_customer_orders catalog metadata contains the updated description.

verification_performed.command: python -c "import duckdb; c=duckdb.connect('warehouse.duckdb', read_only=True); print(c.execute('select count(*) as rows, count(distinct customer_id) as customers from main.legacy_customer_orders limit 10000').fetchall()); print(c.execute('describe main.legacy_customer_orders').fetchall())"
verification_performed.result: Bounded profile returned 4 rows and 4 distinct customers; columns include completed_order_count, completed_revenue, first_completed_order_date, and latest_completed_order_date.
